credits: Original SpeechCoachAI interview questions and follow-ups, written 2026-10-25. Fixed rules choose each follow-up; no AI is used.

items.title: Your name
items.text: Hello. Please tell me your name and where you are from.
items.followUpShort: Can you tell me a little more about that place?
items.followUpLong: What do you like most about it?

items.title: Your day
items.text: Hi. How has your day been so far?
items.followUpShort: What did you do this morning?
items.followUpLong: What was the best part of it?

items.title: Your week
items.text: What do you do during the week?
items.followUpShort: What does a normal day look like?
items.followUpLong: Which part of the week do you enjoy most?

items.title: Free time
items.text: What do you like to do in your free time?
items.followUpShort: How often do you do that?
items.followUpLong: How did you start doing it?

items.title: People
items.text: Tell me about your family or the people you live with.
items.followUpShort: What do you usually do together?
items.followUpLong: What is it like to live with them?

items.title: A place
items.text: Describe a place you like to visit.
items.followUpShort: What can a visitor do there?
items.followUpLong: Why would you recommend it to a friend?

items.title: Learning
items.text: What is something new you learned recently?
items.followUpShort: How did you learn it?
items.followUpLong: How will you use it in the future?

items.title: A meal
items.text: Tell me about a meal you enjoyed.
items.followUpShort: Who was with you?
items.followUpLong: What made that meal special?

items.title: A habit
items.text: What is one habit you would like to change, and why?
items.followUpShort: What makes it hard to change?
items.followUpLong: What would be the first small step?

items.title: Change of plans
items.text: Describe a time when plans changed and you had to adjust.
items.followUpShort: How did you feel at that moment?
items.followUpLong: What did that experience teach you?

items.title: Daily life
items.text: How has your daily life changed over the last few years?
items.followUpShort: Which change has mattered most?
items.followUpLong: Would you go back to the way things were?

items.title: Anything else
items.text: Is there anything else you would like to tell me?
items.followUpShort: Is there something you would like to ask me?
items.followUpLong: Thank you. That was clear and well organized.

items.title: Next
items.text: What would you like to learn or do next?
items.followUpShort: Why does that interest you?
items.followUpLong: What will you do to get started?

items.title: Introduction
items.text: Thank you for coming in. Please introduce yourself.
items.followUpShort: Can you tell me a little about your background?
items.followUpLong: Which part of your background is most useful for this role?

items.title: Background
items.text: Tell me a little about your work or study background.
items.followUpShort: What was your main job in that role?
items.followUpLong: What was the most important thing you learned there?

items.title: Interest
items.text: Why are you interested in this job?
items.followUpShort: What do you know about our company?
items.followUpLong: What would you like to do here in the first month?

items.title: Strengths
items.text: What are your main strengths?
items.followUpShort: Can you give an example of one strength?
items.followUpLong: How did you build that strength?

items.title: A task
items.text: Tell me about a task you did well.
items.followUpShort: What was your part in the task?
items.followUpLong: What would you do differently next time?

items.title: A problem
items.text: Describe a problem you solved at work or school.
items.followUpShort: What did you do first?
items.followUpLong: How did you know the solution worked?

items.title: Teamwork
items.text: How do you work with other people?
items.followUpShort: Can you describe a team you enjoyed?
items.followUpLong: How do you handle a disagreement in a team?

items.title: Time
items.text: How do you manage your time when you are very busy?
items.followUpShort: What do you do first when everything is urgent?
items.followUpLong: Tell me about a time this plan worked well.

items.title: A mistake
items.text: Tell me about a time you made a mistake. What did you do?
items.followUpShort: What did you learn from it?
items.followUpLong: How do you prevent that kind of mistake now?

items.title: Feedback
items.text: How do you react when someone gives you critical feedback?
items.followUpShort: Can you give a recent example?
items.followUpLong: What changed after that feedback?

items.title: Future
items.text: Where do you see yourself in three years?
items.followUpShort: What skills do you want to build?
items.followUpLong: How does this job fit into that plan?

items.title: Why you
items.text: Why should we choose you for this role?
items.followUpShort: What makes your experience different?
items.followUpLong: What result could you deliver in the first six months?

items.title: Questions
items.text: Do you have any questions for us?
items.followUpShort: Is there anything about the team you would like to know?
items.followUpLong: Thank you. Those are thoughtful questions.

items.title: Last words
items.text: Is there anything you would like to add before we finish?
items.followUpShort: Is there one last point you want me to remember?
items.followUpLong: Thank you for your time today.

items.title: Welcome
items.text: Welcome. Please tell me about yourself.
items.followUpShort: What do you study, or what would you like to study?
items.followUpLong: What made you choose that subject?

items.title: Background
items.text: Tell me about your education so far.
items.followUpShort: What was your favorite subject?
items.followUpLong: What did that subject teach you about yourself?

items.title: Subject
items.text: Why do you want to study this subject?
items.followUpShort: When did you first become interested in it?
items.followUpLong: What would you like to do with it?

items.title: A course
items.text: What did you enjoy most in your last course?
items.followUpShort: Can you describe one lesson?
items.followUpLong: What would you change about that course?

items.title: A project
items.text: Describe a project you worked on.
items.followUpShort: What was your role in it?
items.followUpLong: What was the hardest part, and how did you solve it?

items.title: Study time
items.text: How do you organize your study time?
items.followUpShort: Where do you usually study?
items.followUpLong: What do you do when you feel tired or lose focus?

items.title: A hard topic
items.text: Tell me about a difficult topic and how you learned it.
items.followUpShort: What helped you most?
items.followUpLong: How would you explain it to a beginner?

items.title: Groups
items.text: How do you work in a group?
items.followUpShort: What role do you usually take?
items.followUpLong: How do you deal with a group member who does not help?

items.title: After study
items.text: What do you want to do after you finish your studies?
items.followUpShort: Why does that appeal to you?
items.followUpLong: What is your plan if the first option does not work?

items.title: An idea
items.text: What is a book, article or idea that influenced you?
items.followUpShort: What was its main point?
items.followUpLong: Do you still agree with it today?

items.title: Questions
items.text: Do you have any questions for us?
items.followUpShort: Is there something about the program you would like to know?
items.followUpLong: Thank you. Those are thoughtful questions.

items.title: Last words
items.text: Is there anything you would like to add?
items.followUpShort: Is there one last point you want me to remember?
items.followUpLong: Thank you for your time today.
